summary.zh: 汇总 v0.453.0 之后的本地更新：消息排队与附件编辑、稳定的历史加载和滚动、会话后台交接与定时结果、OAuth 账号和模型目录修复，以及附件交付和七天活动历史保留。
summary.en: Consolidates the local changes after v0.453.0: queued input and attachment editing, stable history and scrolling, session-owned background work and automation, safer OAuth and model discovery, reliable file delivery, and seven-day activity retention.

source.releaseNotes: Release preparation; see docs/releases/v0.460.0.md for verification scope, retention behavior, and compatibility notes.

title.zh: 可编辑、可撤回的会话消息队列

summary.zh: 忙时默认排队，支持排序、编辑和逐条发送；读取附件期间撤回有效，切会话不误投，也不重复发送。
summary.en: Queue while busy, reorder and edit pending messages, and send sequentially. Withdrawal during attachment loading works without cross-session delivery or duplicate sends.

title.zh: 当前任务交给后台继续
title.en: Hand current work to a background session

summary.zh: 隔离后台会话继承父会话权限；交接等待真正空闲，停止失败或超时就取消。
summary.en: Isolated background sessions inherit parent permissions. Handoff waits for real idleness and cancels when stopping fails or times out.

title.zh: 会话定时与固定位置的检查结果

summary.zh: 会话定时与巡查分区，检查结果回到原回合；修复检查状态残留、历史结论覆盖和确认卡隐藏。
summary.en: Separate session timers from patrol jobs and anchor results to their originating turns, with reliable check states, retained conclusions, and visible approval cards.

title.zh: 账号真实模型目录与统一参数参考
title.en: Account-derived catalogs and consistent model references

summary.zh: 在线查询优先使用账号目录，补齐本地模型资料；思考档、上下文与模态保留用户明确设置，修复旧目录版本漏掉 Sol。
summary.en: Prefer account-derived catalogs, expand local references, preserve explicit thinking/context/modality settings, and fix stale client-version discovery that omitted Sol.

details.zh: 目录条目不保证所有账号或渠道都能调用。
details.en: Catalog entries do not guarantee availability for every account or provider.

sources.title: Model reference lookup and OAuth discovery

title.zh: 新增 Meta 供应商入口

summary.zh: 补入 Meta API Key 预设、Responses 接入与 Muse 模型参考，账号是否可用以实际渠道为准。
summary.en: Add the Meta API-key preset, Responses integration, and Muse model references, subject to actual provider availability.

title.zh: OAuth 账号刷新与速度权益不再串状态
title.en: Keep OAuth refresh and service-tier state scoped

summary.zh: 旧快照不再复活已删账号或撤销切号，优先使用活槽新凭证；Ultrafast 同时检查当前账号权益与模型支持。Grok 客户端标记升至 1.0.13，修复 426 版本拦截。
summary.en: Stale refresh snapshots no longer resurrect deleted accounts or undo switches. Prefer live credentials and gate Ultrafast by current-account entitlement and model support. Update the Grok client marker to 1.0.13 to fix HTTP 426 version rejection.

details.zh: 未知或普通套餐保留 Standard/Fast；高价套餐正向分支使用模拟响应验证。
details.en: Unknown and ordinary plans retain Standard/Fast; higher-tier positive cases were verified with simulated responses.

sources.title: OAuth vault races and Codex entitlement checks

title.zh: 补齐历史漏加载与上下滚动抽动
title.en: Fix missing history and unstable transcript scrolling

summary.zh: 首屏缺提问或不足一屏也能补页；按阅读消息保持位置，修正高度补偿、虚拟间距和停流折叠，保留正常贴底。
summary.en: Load older history even when the first page lacks the question or cannot scroll. Anchor reading position across prepends, virtual spacing, height changes, and stream-end folding while preserving bottom-follow behavior.

title.zh: 附件编辑、预览与交付语义补齐
title.en: Reliable attachment editing, previews, and delivery

summary.zh: 修复多图补读错位、删光附件仍带回和新图片丢失；交付兼容空占位，明确报告参数错误与部分失败。
summary.en: Fix reordered image recovery, deleted attachments reappearing, and lost pasted images. Delivery tolerates unused placeholders and reports invalid parameters and partial failures explicitly.

title.zh: 立即停止后仍能保存推理档位
title.en: Save thinking settings immediately after stopping

summary.zh: 首字前可停止；保存推理档位时按需静默恢复会话实例，无需先生成一轮回复，旧回包不串改新会话。
summary.en: Stop before the first token and quietly restore the session runtime when saving thinking settings, without requiring another model reply or applying late results to another chat.

sources.title: Pre-stream cancellation and post-abort thinking settings

title.zh: 后台结果去重与停止状态保护
title.en: Deduplicate background results and preserve stopped state

summary.zh: 按运行批次记录完整结果消费，覆盖状态查询与待办查询；续接结果不误吞，停止后的旧循环唤醒不再覆盖新状态。
summary.en: Record full-result consumption per run across status and pending-result queries, preserve continuation results, and discard stale loop wakeups after stopping.

title.zh: 错误、更新状态与界面竞态修正
title.en: Correct error handling, update labels, and UI races

summary.zh: 区分请求过大与限流，移除无依据的重试文案；修复代理指纹、远程卡片票据、折叠偏好和内部标签显示，并区分内容更新与桌面外壳更新。
summary.en: Separate oversized requests from rate limits, remove unsupported retry claims, fix proxy fingerprints, remote card tickets, collapse preferences and internal labels, and distinguish content updates from desktop-shell updates.

sources.title: Retry policy, proxy state, card tickets, and UI consistency

title.zh: 已结束活动历史最多保留七天
title.en: Retain completed activity history for seven days

summary.zh: 已结束记录保留七天、最多一百条；启动、读取和写入时清理，保护运行中记录、共享会话文件、任务配置与工作产物。
summary.en: Retain up to seven days and one hundred completed records, pruning on startup, reads, and writes while protecting active records, shared session files, job definitions, and work products.

details.zh: 过期历史及其专属活动会话会被删除；需要保留旧历史时请先备份。
details.en: Expired history and its dedicated activity-session files are removed; back up older history first if it must be retained.
